recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-portrait browser game titled “Conference Room Confessional.” It is mechanically a dress-up/customizer toy: the player taps Start Interview, chooses category tabs, uses previous/next arrows to wrap through options, sees the avatar update immediately on canvas, and taps Air It to lock the final look. Preserve that loop exactly.

Theme it as workplace cringe comedy inspired by deadpan documentary office humor: a lovable incompetent office worker is being prepared for an awkward interview cutaway. Use office roles, wrinkled work fits, novelty ties, mugs, name badges, forced smiles, camera glances, conference blinds, sticky notes, copier jams, mandatory-fun memos, and REC-camera HUD treatment. Optimize for portrait aspect ratios from 4:7 to 9:16 with a large bottom control sheet, readable labels, and touch-friendly buttons.

Primary prompt: Workplace cringe comedy. A satirical game inspired by The Office with awkward social mini-games, deadpan documentary humor, office politics, lovable incompetence, cringe timing, and mundane-chaos meme energy with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first canvas dress-up/customizer toy
- objective: start the booth, choose category tabs, cycle visual variants with previous/next arrows, and lock/save the final look.
- input model: tap/click start, category tabs, previous/next arrow buttons, save button, and sound toggle; no drag, keyboard, collision, timer, or score input.
- core loop: render a centered avatar on canvas, select a customization category, wrap through options, update the label and avatar immediately, show short feedback, optionally save/lock.
- fail/friction state: there is no loss state; friction is limited to mobile readability, category overflow scrolling, and transient feedback overlays.

## Protected mechanics
- Preserve start overlay removal before play.
- Preserve category tab selection and active category highlighting.
- Preserve previous/next wraparound cycling for every category.
- Preserve immediate canvas redraw from state changes.
- Preserve save/lock feedback and sound-toggle behavior.
- Preserve portrait-first one-thumb bottom control sheet and tappable controls.

## Remixed target
Conference Room Confessional reframes the same customization loop as an awkward documentary interview preparation game. The player dresses a lovable incompetent office worker for a deadpan cutaway by cycling office roles, work fits, props, expressions, and set dressing. The old cozy deskcore presentation is replaced with procedural conference-room blinds, copier chaos, sticky-note memos, REC camera styling, cringe-reaction chips, and office-politics copy while the protected dress-up mechanics remain intact.
